payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Emil, Frida, Hipolito, Lamont, Lawanna, Raymond

payload.content: Planning (Lawanna): my top skill ui-ux-design. I can take at most one of ISSUE-0001::{review,docs,triage,test,implement}. I will likely prefer review/docs/triage due to low cost; will avoid implement/test unless others skip. Communicating availability=10h, costs: review=1.09 docs=1.09 triage=1.09 test=1.52 implement=2.17. I will coordinate to prevent duplicates.

Planning (Lawanna): please claim distinct ISSUE-0001 micro-tasks among you (review/docs/triage/test/implement). If someone needs UI-UX help, I can cover review/docs/triage. If all higher-value UI-UX tasks are taken, I may skip.

Planning: I’m Emil (avail 9h). My best tags are data-science (0.84) and ui-ux-design (0.68). To minimize my cost, I’m leaning ISSUE-0001::{review|docs|triage} (cost 1.28 each). I will avoid ISSUE-0002 data-science tasks (very high cost). I’ll coordinate with Lawanna/Lamont to prevent duplicates on ISSUE-0001 micro-tasks.
Lawanna: I can take ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage. If you want review, tell me; otherwise I’ll grab one of the remaining ones to maximize distinct task completion.

Planning (Raymond): I’m taking at most one micro-task. My strongest tags are data-science (0.86) and documentation (0.81); for ISSUE-0002 I can do review/test/implement but implement is likely infeasible cost-wise (8.59 within 9h but high). For ISSUE-0001 UI-UX tasks are very high cost to me (>=10). I propose I take ISSUE-0002::review (effort 4.0, priority high) to avoid overlapping with any UI-UX selections; please coordinate to prevent duplicates on ISSUE-0002::review.
Planning (Raymond): If ISSUE-0002::review is already taken by another agent, my next-best would be ISSUE-0002::test (effort 5.6) else I will skip rather than take an expensive ISSUE-0001 task.

Planning (Frida): my top skills ui-ux-design + some data-science but ISSUE-0002 tasks are too costly vs my 4h. I’m considering claiming one distinct ISSUE-0001 micro-task among {review, docs, triage} to avoid duplicates and maximize tasks_done. Let me know which of those are still free—otherwise I’ll take ISSUE-0001::docs (effort 1.0, cost 0.96).

Planning (Frida): If others take ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage, I will skip rather than take higher-effort implement/test or any ISSUE-0002 data-science (efforts 4-8+ and my costs huge relative to 4h).

Hipolito planning: I’m good at ui-ux-design docs and can do UI-UX review/docs/triage/test/implement for ISSUE-0001. Given my costs: review/docs/triage=1.36 (effort 1h), test=1.90 (1.4h), implement=2.71 (2h). I’ll avoid ISSUE-0002 (too costly). I will pick one distinct ISSUE-0001 task—please confirm which of review/docs/triage are still free to prevent duplicates.

Hipolito coordination request: If Lawanna claims implement, I can take review/docs/triage; if Emil takes review/docs/triage, I’ll take one of remaining ISSUE-0001 micro-tasks. My best low-cost choices are review/docs/triage.

[Lawanna planning] I will target a distinct ISSUE-0001 micro-task with low cost (review/docs/triage). To avoid duplicates: please tell me which of review/docs/triage are still unclaimed on your side; otherwise I’ll pick one (likely review) given lowest cost ties. My availability=10h.
[Lawanna coordination] If you already have ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage, I will select the remaining one among them (or skip). I will avoid implement/test to minimize cost/effort.
Emil->Coalition: I’m taking ISSUE-0001::review OR docs OR triage (one only), cost 1.28 each; avoiding ISSUE-0002 due to high cost. Lamont claims ISSUE-0002::review; I will not duplicate.

Raymond planning: aiming to claim ISSUE-0002::review if free (effort 4.0, priority high). If someone already takes it, I’ll instead take ISSUE-0002::test; otherwise I’ll skip (to avoid costly ISSUE-0001 UI-UX tasks). Please confirm whether ISSUE-0002::review is unclaimed before you assign.

Frida planning: I will claim one distinct ISSUE-0001 micro-task among {review, docs, triage} based on what’s still unclaimed. Given my costs, best are docs/review/triage (~0.96 each). Please reply indicating which of ISSUE-0001::review, ISSUE-0001::docs, ISSUE-0001::triage are already taken/being taken, so I can avoid duplicates. I’m avoiding ISSUE-0001 implement/test and all ISSUE-0002 tasks (too costly for my 4h).

Hipolito planning: I will claim exactly one ISSUE-0001 micro-task. From the comms it sounds like Emil is targeting ISSUE-0001::review|docs|triage (one only) and Lawanna also wants one among {review, docs, triage}. To avoid duplicates, I propose taking ISSUE-0001::triage unless someone has already claimed it. Please confirm on-board which of {ISSUE-0001::review, ISSUE-0001::docs, ISSUE-0001::triage} are already taken; otherwise I’ll proceed with triage.

Lawanna planning update: I’m ready to claim one distinct ISSUE-0001 low-cost UI-UX micro-task (review/docs/triage). Please confirm which of ISSUE-0001::review, ::docs, ::triage are already reserved so I can pick the remaining one or skip to avoid duplicates.

Emil planning update: I will take ISSUE-0001::review (effort 1.0, priority high, cost 1.28). I am avoiding ISSUE-0002 tasks to stay within availability and avoid high cost. Please avoid claiming ISSUE-0001::review to prevent duplicates.

Planning (Raymond): I will take ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed; if already taken, I’ll take ISSUE-0002::test; otherwise I’ll skip to avoid expensive ISSUE-0001 UI-UX tasks. Please confirm ISSUE-0002::review availability—others: Emil/Lamont mentioned but not on this board for execution.

Frida planning update: I will avoid duplicates with Emil (likely ISSUE-0001::review) and Hipolito/Lawanna (review/docs/triage). If ISSUE-0001::docs is free, I will take ISSUE-0001::docs (effort 1.0, cost 0.96). Please confirm whether ISSUE-0001::docs is already claimed; otherwise I proceed with docs.

Hipolito planning update: I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 1.0, priority high) unless it’s already reserved by you all. Please confirm if any agent (Lawanna/Emil/Frida) already picked triage; otherwise I proceed with triage to keep tasks distinct.
Also: I’m avoiding ISSUE-0002 due to high cost/effort vs availability. Open options for me if triage is taken: ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::review (whichever is free).

Planning update (Lawanna): I see Emil intends ISSUE-0001::review, Hipolito intends ISSUE-0001::triage, Frida is leaning ISSUE-0001::docs if free. To avoid duplicates, I will not take review/triage; please confirm ISSUE-0001::docs is free. If docs is taken, I will skip.

Raymond planning update: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed; if already taken, I can take ISSUE-0002::test; otherwise I will skip to avoid overlapping/expensive ISSUE-0001 tasks. Please confirm ISSUE-0002::review availability (only one claim needed).

Frida (planning): tracking claims—Emil->ISSUE-0001::review; Hipolito->ISSUE-0001::triage; Raymond intends ISSUE-0002::review; Lawanna asks about ISSUE-0001::docs being free. I intend to take ISSUE-0001::docs if unclaimed; otherwise I will skip.

Planning update (Hipolito): based on current comms, Emil=ISSUE-0001::review, Hipolito=ISSUE-0001::triage (unless already taken), Frida likely=ISSUE-0001::docs, Raymond=ISSUE-0002::review. I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage if still unclaimed; otherwise I’ll skip to avoid duplicates.
